payload.explanation: The diagnostic report identifies the business request (session_7d4bb70fb3a2) as blocked on a lock chain rooted at session_dba40d91be8d, an idle-in-transaction session whose last statement was an UPDATE on inventory and which is not itself blocked — the root blocker. The state report confirms session_dba40d91be8d is eligible for rollback_session under the policy registry, while the business request session must not be modified directly. Rolling back the root blocker releases the lock chain so the pending decrement can complete; no evidence supports large-data, index, or vacuum causes.
